description: Sixteen random voltages redrawn together whenever a trigger arrives; the randomness is generated inside the module and there is no signal input to sample.

inputs.text: A rising edge draws sixteen fresh random values, each spread evenly across -5V to +5V.

outputs.text: One of the sixteen held voltages, steady between one trigger and the next.

notes: Every output stays at 0V until the first trigger reaches TRIG.

inputs.0: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
